{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to float, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Calculate conversion rate per customer_segment
# Conversion rate = (number of converted orders) / (total number of orders)
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
conversion_rates['conversion_rate'] = conversion_rates['sum'] / conversion_rates['count']

# Sort by conversion rate descending
conversion_rates_sorted = conversion_rates_sorted = conversion_rates.sort_values(by='conversion_rate', ascending=False)

# Extract the segment with highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rates_sorted.index[0]

# Print results
print(conversion_rates_sorted)
print(f"Highest conversion rate segment: {highest_segment}")"}
